title: Atari 7800
description: An A78 file: the 128-byte header, then a linear ROM ending at $FFFF or a SuperGame board's 16 KB banks (the last fixed at $C000, the others switched in at $8000); flow from the reset, NMI and IRQ vectors in the last six bytes. The TIA by its read and write names, MARIA and the RIOT, written in DASM.
